clauses.original_text: Contractor grants Client perpetual, worldwide ownership of all IP created during or outside the contract period.

asymmetry.imbalance_explanation: The clause grants ownership of IP created even outside the scope of work, which is highly predatory.

clauses.plain_english_consequence: You are giving away the rights to any ideas or work you create, even on your own time.
clauses.fair_counter_clause: Ownership limited solely to agreed milestone deliverables.
clauses.suggested_negotiation_script: I am happy to assign rights for the specific deliverables agreed upon, but I must retain ownership of IP created outside this contract.

unauthorized_practice_disclaimer: ClauseShield assists with comprehension and is not certified legal representation.
